format: SIM-inspired experimental history, not Google's CRSI optimizer

problems.root_cause: The eager trie serialized entire subtrees even behind wildcard edges.

attempts.intervention: Split lazy trie with persistent pending subtree stack
attempts.rationale: Skip irrelevant subtrees before visiting descendants
attempts.predicted: Fewer encoding visits and lower total ledger than split eager trie
attempts.outcome: Encoding prediction met; total-work prediction missed. Stack cells cost more than savings on small expressions.
attempts.decision: Keep exact lazy matcher as control; use split scan for small library.

case_audit.provenance: 6c reused target expressions, seeds 31000–31071; retrospective reconstruction, not pre-registered case-ID predictions

problems.root_cause: Mixed root buckets charge irrelevant macro probes during primitive-only normalization.

attempts.rationale: A primitive query need not touch macro candidates.
attempts.predicted: Reduce random-family recognition tax and retain proof trace

observed.old_accounting_differs: New ledger also charges sort comparisons and group construction.

attempts.outcome: Tax shrank from 235.21 to 141.83 units, but remains positive; not an isolated timing result.
attempts.decision: Retain split buckets; investigate prepass gating on untouched data.

case_audit.provenance: 6b vs 6c random family; changed ledger, descriptive only

problems.root_cause: Macro substitution computed twice per successful prepass match.

attempts.rationale: The exact same immutable result was already constructed for size checking.
attempts.predicted: Reduce substitution count without modifying certificate

case_audit.provenance: 6c matched split-scan substitution ablation, retrospectively classified

problems.root_cause: Early canonical reassociation destroys a macro's own input interface.

attempts.intervention: Derive wrapped RHS by two associativity steps (6b)
attempts.rationale: Preserve internal compositional representation until final lowering
attempts.predicted: Longer conjugate chains admit successive macro hits

observed.chain2_terminal_lowering_advantage: Original macro cheaper at n=2; wrapper requires terminal lowering.

attempts.decision: Preserve internal wrapper, lower at boundary; not a universal asymptotic claim.

problems.root_cause: Discrete rotation search may waste work enumerating angles a direct elimination can derive.

attempts.intervention: Compare exact rational data-dependent Givens against fixed-action greedy and bounded orbit search
attempts.rationale: Isolate physical coefficient-dependent angle selection from symbolic rewrite scheduling
attempts.predicted: No winning arm or case IDs specified before run; protocol froze corpus and controls.
attempts.domain: TWC-derived rational symmetric coupling matrices; experiment 7a
attempts.decision: Use rational Givens as strong exact control; design untouched harder topology/cost constraints before testing macro learning or equality saturation.

problems.root_cause: Rational-only pivot generation excluded most continuous Givens angles; canonical sparsity and target-mask realization are different tasks.

attempts.intervention: Continuous source-aligned tridiagonal reduction plus constrained pivot search
attempts.domain: TWC-derived symmetric coupling matrices; dense 52000–52011, constrained 61000–61023
attempts.rationale: Remove Pythagorean bottleneck and test prescribed physical topology

predictions.reason: Forgot direct source-load edge; correct count 2n+1; no output relabeling.

attempts.decision: Keep canonical reduction as primitive; compare stronger local optimization.

attempts.intervention: Damped least squares over internal rotations
attempts.rationale: Use full local residual Jacobian instead of single edge-pivot selection

case_audit.note: Retrospective success IDs; not forward predictions.

attempts.decision: Promote to mandatory baseline. Seven misses remain unproved infeasible; target generator proves feasible. Do not start macro training on these diagnostic targets.

problems.root_cause: Full-plane optimization ignores degree-one port constraints; finite differences spend rotations estimating known commutator derivatives.

attempts.intervention: Analytic Lie Jacobian, degree-one port alignment, two/eight-start matched ablations
attempts.rationale: Remove avoidable search dimensions and numerical derivative rotations before testing learned warm starts.

predictions.claim: Pinned port leakage <=1e-12 after alignment and throughout restricted updates

attempts.decision: Use analytic mask-aware multistart as mandatory control; single free plane direct candidate check also mandatory when applicable. Fresh 7c cases now diagnostic, not future holdout. Learned warm-start experiment must use new source/target split.

problems.root_cause: Full-plane normal-equation cost and unsuccessful restricted restarts; test transferable solver organs.

attempts.intervention: 7d source-only parameterized motifs and staged schedules
attempts.decision: Do not promote whole-motif mining: mostly empty or singleton. Staged schedules need comparison to hand and shuffled controls; combined arm not assumed best. Fixed release schedule is not an adaptive stagnation regulator. See 7d README and summary.

problems.root_cause: 7d n=6 unpinned full normal-equation cost; test cheap live subspace assembly against optimized full solver.

attempts.intervention: 7e online sparse pursuit vs normalized GS/random/coupled blocks and stronger full classical kernel

P3.note: budget/ledger checks executed for all rows; absence of full assembly Gram confirmed by code inspection, not dynamic instrumentation

attempts.decision: Do not promote 5-plane online block policy. Prefer stronger full classical symmetric Gram/Cholesky control. Investigate forced full steps and assembly cost only on diagnostics before new frozen corpus.

problems.root_cause: 7e exclusive workspace loses global coupling and assembly cost dominates; 7f tests full-plane selective precision and cached classical LM.

attempts.intervention: 7f diagonal/global, block precision, PCG3 and cached full LM at n=6/7/8

P4.note: same-state identity assertion ran on cache hits, no violations

attempts.decision: Promote cached full LM as control. Do not promote selective precision: no solved n=8 cases and approximate arms lose at n=6/7. Investigate representation/initialization and solver convergence rather than claim cost-only scaling gain.
